Package com.saicone.delivery4j.broker

Class KafkaBroker<K>

java.lang.Object
com.saicone.delivery4j.Broker
com.saicone.delivery4j.broker.KafkaBroker<K>
Type Parameters:
K - the key object type.
public class KafkaBroker<K> extends Broker
Kafka broker implementation to publish and consumer using empty-keys records.
Take in count that any producer and consumer used in this instance should be compatible with byte array values.
